design_description: A bold Spider-inspired design built around speed, agility, and superhero energy. The dark navy base is contrasted by bright yellow shoulder caps and side inserts, creating a dynamic silhouette that resembles a spider spreading its legs across the jersey. The large white spider emblem dominates the chest, serving as the unmistakable focal point and reinforcing the team identity. On the back, oversized yellow numbering ensures maximum visibility, while the Catalan flag beneath the collar adds a subtle regional signature and personal touch. Overall, the kit feels powerful, modern, and instantly recognizable — combining comic-book inspiration with a clean football aesthetic.
